name: co.yungle/yungle
description: Ask about your Yungle transfers, share files as links, approve every send. Hosted or local.

environmentVariables.name: YUNGLE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Yungle API key from https://yungle.co/dashboard/settings/api. Read scopes to answer questions; add transfers:write to share links. Or skip keys: connect to https://yungle.co/mcp and sign in.

environmentVariables.name: YUNGLE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Only useful for development against a local Yungle instance; leave unset to use https://yungle.co/api/v1.
